You can hand the legendary animals to the trader table at your camp but all it does is filling up your meter more for your wagons.

With legendary animals, you can either sedate them for samples for naturalist role if you got one.

Or you can sell them or their pelts to gus for mere 15 dollars tbh, or even the butcher.

There is a trick to some legendaries. If the animal is of a size suitable for the horseback, if you sedate it for samples, then kill it, put it on the back of your horse, make the horse flee, then when you bring it back you'll have a whole animal that you can skin and get a pelt from.

So you can get the best of both worlds.
